batch: Super Soul 045 acquisition and Ki mechanics enrichment

record.name: Your time in this fight ends now!
findings: Current catalogue reports +100 Ki for Instant Transmission.
Independent GameFAQs testing reports approximately one Ki bar for ordinary Instant Transmission and up to two bars at close range.
Saibaman raid documentation identifies the Super Soul as a 15,000-damage individual reward; later Great Ape Baby Lite reruns also document it as a reward.
unresolved: exact conditions behind the close-range two-bar observation

policy: Keep the registered/catalogue +100 Ki value as canonical secondary data while preserving bar-count observations separately; do not infer a universal two-bar rule.
